{{Quote|Are you sure they will find us?''"<br />"''Yes, my master. They cannot miss the clues. Everything is proceeding as you predicted.''"<br />"''Good. Make sure our friends are welcomed&hellip;appropriately.''"<br />"''As you command, my lady. '''Thaum Rystra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As a [[Youngling/Legends|child]], Rystra's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] was discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and he was trained in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to serve the Empire's [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. After [[Death/Legends|slaying]] his parents at the behest of his Imperial masters, Rystra was horrified by his actions and abandoned the Empire to enlist in the anti-Imperial [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. While [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] an unmapped [[Star system/Legends|system]] on behalf of the Alliance, Rystra encountered the [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]] [[Valik Kodank]] and, enthralled by her offer of power, became Kodank's apprentice.

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Kodank set in motion a scheme to restore her physical form and to that end she tasked Rystra with capturing [[Caeleb]], a [[Youngling/Legends|child]] strong in the Force, and acquiring the powerful [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side relic]] the [[Soulsaber]]. After an unsuccessful attempt to abduct Caeleb on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]], in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] Rystra kidnapped the child from a Rebel Alliance safe world and with Caeleb's assistance stole the Soulsaber from a [[Cavern of Light|hidden cavern]] on a [[ZXK-100346.6a|remote Outer Rim world]]. [[7 ABY/Legends|Three years later]], Rystra lured a group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] agents to Kodank's [[Temple of Pain|Sith temple]] so that Kodank could attempt to possess the body [[Force Adept|Force adept]] [[Sha'lia]]. However, the operatives defeated Rystra and vanquished Kodank.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|I know what you desire, Thaum Rystra, and I can give it to you. Become my servant and the power of the Force shall be yours.|Valik Kodank, as she seduced Rystra to the dark side of the Force|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
Thaum Rystra was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from<ref name="Child of Light" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Youngling/Legends|son]] of a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] and his wife, during Rystra's childhood his family relocated regularly as his father was reassigned to better postings, resulting in an unusual upbringing. When Rystra was eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, his family moved to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Child of Light" /> the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world.<ref name="Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> Rystra's Force-sensitivity soon came to the Empire's attention and the Imperials earmarked him for training in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in service to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. An [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|advisor]] of the Imperial leader [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] informed Rystra's parents that their boy was to be taken away to undergo special training for gifted youngsters; despite his parents' protests Rystra was forcibly escorted away by the man and several Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], crying desperately at being parted from his family.<ref name="Child of Light" />

During his subsequent training, Rystra was educated in the use of the Force and instilled with loyalty to the Empire. He was schooled in how to identify traitors to the regime and as final lesson he was dispatched to eliminate two individuals that had betrayed the Empire. Equipped with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] weapon, Rystra snuck into the residence of his targets at night whilst the pair were [[Sleep/Legends|asleep]]. Striking the pair down in their [[Sleeper (furniture)|bed]] with his blade, at the last moment Rystra activated a [[Glow panel/Legends|glowpanel]] and to his horror realized his targets to be his parents. Aghast at what a monster he had became, Rystra abandoned the Empire and fled in a stolen [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Child of Light" />

Seeking to atone for his crimes and combat the Empire, Rystra determined to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], an anti-Imperial insurgent group. After [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of searching, he made contact with the Rebels and joined their cause.<ref name="Child of Light" /> Rystra attained the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref> and was teamed with several beings holding similar anti-Imperial views including a Force-sensitive [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. Uncomfortable in the presence of another Force user, Rystra eventually arranged a transfer from his unit to become a [[Scout/Legends|scout]].<ref name="Child of Light" />

On his third assignment as a Rebel scout, Rystra was tasked with charting an unmapped [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Child of Light" /> in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> containing the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]].<ref name="Light and Dark" /> There, through the Force Rystra [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] the voice of the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] adept [[Valik Kodank]] reaching out to him. Directed by her call, Rystra [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] his starship into the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] to her location<ref name="Child of Light" /> at the [[Temple of Pain]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith temple]] situated on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] within the nebula's depths.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> After landing his vessel, awed by the strength of the Force in the temple and compelled by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to press on, Rystra followed Kodank's voice deep inside the edifice. At the entry way to a large chamber, the spirit of Kodank manifested and spoke into Rystra's mind, claiming to know his desires and offering him power in the Force if he became her servant. Rystra accepted her offer and surrendered to the dark side.<ref name="Child of Light" />

===Mission to Dalicron-4===
{{Quote|I am transmitting the co-ordinates of the target. Kill the guardians and bring the boy to me.''"<br />"''It shall be done, my master. I will not fail you.|Thaum Rystra and Tol Skaros|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
Kodank promised to teach Rystra the ways of the Sith and under her tutelage he became a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]<ref name="Child of Light" /> and [[dark side adept]].<ref name="Soulsaber" /> He took the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tol Skaros]] as his own Dark Jedi apprentice and taught Skaros much about the dark side of the Force. The Whiphid demonstrated total loyalty to Rystra and in preparation for future conflicts with other Force users, Rystra instructed Skaros in the fighting techniques employed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="Child of Light" /> a Force-wielding [[Jedi Order/Legends|order]] outlawed by the Empire.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Rystra also made contributions to Skaros' weapons arsenal.<ref name="Child of Light" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">"[[Child of Light]]" is set four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], an event dated by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' to the sixth month of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. As the ''Atlas'' states that there are twelve months in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], it can therefore be inferred that ''Child of Light'' takes place in the tenth month of 3 ABY. [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']] is set approximately four months after ''Child of Light'' and can thus be dated to the second month of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']] is set just over three years after ''Soulsaber'' and is therefore placed in around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> Kodank tasked Rystra with bringing to her [[Caeleb]], the prophesied "Child of Light", a being strong in the Force who the Sith spirit believed could help her to regain her physical form. Rystra tracked the child to the sparsely-populated planet [[Dalicron-4]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and traveled to the world in an [[MRX-BR Pacifier]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]], landing his ship in the village [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]]. Skaros joined him in Dalia and over course of the next [[Standard week/Legends|week]], Rystra hung about in the township, posing as a down-on-his-luck freelance courier whose starship was in need of repair after coming under fire from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that mistook him for a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. He got to know the locals and made the acquaintance of the<ref name="Child of Light" /> [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> [[Corvin]].<ref name="Child of Light" />

Rystra pinpointed Caeleb's location to a homestead several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] journey from Dalia and transmitted the co-ordinates to Skaros, contacting the Whiphid remotely via a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] to provide him with orders to capture Caeleb and kill the child's guardians. The boy's parents were both Force-sensitive and Rystra reasoned that fighting them would provide Skaros good practice in combating other Force users. While Skaros made his way to Caeleb's homestead a group of Rebel agents arrived in Dalia on a mission to take the Child of Light into the custody of the Alliance.<ref name="Child of Light" /> Rystra had not foreseen the Rebels' involvement and chose not to immediately move against them, instead seeking to observe their next steps.<ref name="Soulsaber" /> Rystra approached the Rebels in the [[Cantina/Legends|inn]] [[Daz's Tavern]] and introduced himself and engaged then in idle conversation, maintaining his cover story that he was just a harmless courier.<ref name="Child of Light" />

A storm broke out and Rystra suggested to the Rebel agents that they wait out the squall in the tavern with him, and he played a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with some local residents while waiting for the storm to settle. The child Zanner, the seven year old son of Corvin, went missing during the storm and the<ref name="Child of Light" /> farmer<ref name="Soulsaber" /> asked Rystra to help find the boy, believing the scout to be his best hope for bringing his son home. Rystra entreated the Rebels to join the effort to find Zanner and advised the search party to maintain caution despite the impetus to bring the boy to safety as quickly as possible. While Rystra escorted Corvin home, the Rebels successfully tracked down Zanner. The following [[Standard day/Legends|day]] Rystra crossed paths with the Rebels again and cheerfully greeted them when they passed by their starship whist he was conducting repairs with a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]].<ref name="Child of Light" />

Later that day, Skaros was killed by the Rebel agents as he attempted to apprehend Caeleb from the Child of Light's home. In the aftermath of the fight, Rystra observed from a distance via a pair of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] the Rebels and the body of his fallen apprentice. His plan for capturing Caeleb frustrated, Rystra determined to follow the Rebels and seize the boy from them when an opportunity arose. He returned to Dalia and came across the Rebels as they headed to their ship leave the planet and launched his starship to follow the Rebels's vessel, the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lazy Katarn]]''. Their path to leave was blocked by the Imperial [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Harasser]]'', which arrived in the system and declared Dalicron-4 to be under Imperial quarantine.<ref name="Child of Light" /> Keen to ensure that the Rebel ship was not targeted by the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] and Caeleb killed,<ref name="Soulsaber" /> Rystra hailed both the Rebel [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and the Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warship]], announcing himself as a Rebel lieutenant that had placed the ''Lazy Katarn'' under his protection. He distracted the Imperials by launching four [[sensor decoy]]s that projected hologram images of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]],<ref name="Child of Light" /> and once the Rebel ship successfully fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] he departed the system himself.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

===Hunt for the Soulsaber===
{{Quote|Lieutenant Ryst&hellip;''"<br />"''No Kylbar. Commander Skywalker. You always did get us confused. I'll take Caeleb now. He will be safe with me.|Kylbar and Thaum Rystra, as Rystra apprehended Caeleb|<ref name="Soulsaber" />}}
Caeleb was hidden by the Rebel Alliance at a secure location on a safe world, but despite the Rebels' security measures Rystra tracked down the boy. He landed at Caeleb's hiding place and [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] the boy's protector, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Kylbar]], into believing Rystra to be [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] of the Alliance, then took charge of Caeleb and departed with the boy.<ref name="Soulsaber" /> With Caeleb now captured, Kodank sent Rystra to bring to her the Soulsaber, an ancient dark side relic that she planned to use in her scheme to regain her physical form.<ref name="Child of Light" /> The Rebel team that Rystra had encountered on Dalicron-4 were sent by the Alliance to find the Dark Jedi and return Caeleb to the Alliance's safekeeping. For [[Standard month/Legends|months]], the Rebels unsuccessful searched for Rystra as he advanced his quest to locate the Soulsaber.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> four months after the death of Tol Skaros on Dalicron-4, Rystra learned that the [[Temples of Vormijj]], a complex of ancient Jedi temples on the planet [[Pamorjal]], contained information concerning the location of the Soulsaber. As a ploy to shake the Rebel agents that were tailing him, Rystra made contact with representatives of the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group, seeking to turn the League against the Rebels. Rystra traveled to the moon [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to meet the group and landed in a private landing bay in a busy [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Some gangsters approach the Dark Jedi and demanded tribute, however Rystra mind tricked a [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] among their group into killing the other hoodlums, then used the Force to kill the Barabel. Rystra met with his contact in bar, warning them about the Rebel agents and informing them that Rystra would soon be venturing to Pamorjal. The [[Information broker/Legends|information merchant]] [[Rat (Human)|Rat]] secret observed Rystra's meeting and provided details of the liaison to the Rebel agents.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

Following his arrival on Pamorjal, Rystra met with the Pamorjal Freemans League leader [[Davit Berek]] and provided him descriptions of the Rebel agents, falsely claiming them to be special agents of the corporation [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]] who sought to exploit Pamorjal's [[garna tree]]s and investigate its temples. While keeping Caeleb closed to him, Rystra investigated the Temples of Vormijj and inside one of the temples discovered a [[Star/Legends|star]] map showing the location of the Soulsaber, in the remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[ZXK-100346 system/Legends|ZXK-100346 system]].<ref name="Soulsaber" />

Rystra progressed to the world [[ZXK-100346.6a]] and found the [[Cavern of Light]], a large [[Cave/Legends|cave]] where the Soulsaber had been hidden by the Jedi [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] earlier. A barrier of [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side Force]] surrounded artifact which could not be crossed by individuals tainted by the dark side. Rystra sent Caeleb to collect the relic<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and as just as the child fetched the relic to him he was confronted by the Rebel agents,<ref name="Light and Dark" /> who had evaded Rystra's attempt to turn the Pamorjal Freeman's League against them. Rystra urged the Rebels to join him, claiming that they had a common enemy in the Empire and that he had the means to defeat the Imperial regime<ref name="Soulsaber" /> A fight ensured and Rystra fled the cavern with the Soulsaber, leaving Caeleb behind with the Rebels.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> To delay the Rebels pursuit of him, the Dark Jedi used a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] to bring down the exit tunnel to the cave, then hurried to his ship and left the world.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

===Confrontation at the Temple of Pain===
{{Quote|Please won't you sit? We have much to discuss. It has been a while, my friends. I trust Caeleb is doing well? Shall we play a hand?|The phantom version of Thaum Rystra conjured by Valik Kodank, to the crew of the ''Celestial Dancer''|<ref name="Soulsaber" />}}
Returning to Kodank with the Soulsaber, Rystra spent the next three years studying under the Sith spirit's tutelage, growing his power in the dark side of the Force. He took up residence within Kodank's personal quarters in the Temple of Pain and gathered together a force of pirates to defend the temple. Rystra also studied a [[Sith holocron (Tascollan Nebula)|Sith holocron]] that Kodank kept at the temple. The Dark Jedi's training regimen from Kodank filled his head with so many thoughts that he faced difficulty sleeping, and his weariness left him increasing susceptible to the Sith spirit's influence. Rystra told his master about the Rebel agents that he had faced at the Cavern of Light and Kodank devised to regain her physical form by inhabiting the body of one of the Rebels, the Twi'lek [[Force Adept|Force adept]] [[Sha'lia]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />

The Sith spirit tasked her apprentice with undertaking research on how how she could safely inhabit Sha'lia and to that end Kodank versed him in the ways of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]]. From the temple's [[Room of Change]] laboratory, Rystra performed experiments in [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and refined his technique, [[Writing/Legends|writing]] notes documenting his expanding knowledge. He developed many means of altering [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings, though his procedures frequently cost his subjects their sanity. Among those that he experimented on were four pirates of the pirate group that he had hired to defend the temple; he transformed the [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] of the Twi'lek [[Desvin Tor'thal]] into [[Sith poison]] stingers, augmented the [[Claw/Legends|claws]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Blaschowwa]] and also altered the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Kamtis Bonai]] and the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Vobin Sobos]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />

Circa [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Kodank ordered Rystra to put the next phase of their plan in motion and lure the Rebel agents, who were now servants of the Rebel Alliance's successor the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], to the Temple of Pain. The group had been searching for Rystra since his heist of the Soulsaber and to lure them to the Tascollan Nebula he carefully supplied snippets of information regarding his location to various individuals in his employ. The New Republic agents followed the trail of evidence and flew to the nebula to confront Rystra. Upon their arrival, the Dark Jedi dispatched four pirate-operated [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to open on fire on the group's starship, the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] ''[[Celestial Dancer]]'', as a test of how the team had grown in strength since his last encounter with them.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

The crew of the ''Celestial Dancer'' evaded Rystra's pirates and landed at the Temple of Pain and as team progressed through the Sith stronghold, Kodank conjured an illusory version of Rystra to greet them. The phantom Rystra engaged the operatives in small talk and invited them to play a game of sabacc, distracting them while an explosion occurred which the phantom falsely claimed had destroyed the ''Celestial Dancer'' and all other starships in the temple. The apparition urged the group to progress on, advising that their only means of escape lay deeper in the stronghold. Rystra and his Sith mentor awaited the agents in a cavern far beneath the main structure of the temple and Kodank ordered him to treat all of the team other than Sha'lia as expendable.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

{{RPG|[[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']]}}
When the New Republic agents arrived in the cavern, Kodank and Rystra observed hidden from view as some Sith [[Guardian Spirit]]s attacked the group. Once the operatives had vanquished the spirits, Rystra and his master revealed themselves and Rystra made a plea for that the group join forces with Kodank. The New Republic agents rejected his offer and Rystra and his mentor attacked the group, fighting alongside a [[Mutant|mutated]] [[Battle hydra/Legends|battle hydra]] summoned by Kodank while the Sith spirit attempted to possess Sha'lia. However, Rystra was defeated in the struggle and Kodank vanquished.<ref name="Light and Dark" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Well, just settle in. These things can get real nasty. Daz's is about as safe as it gets during one of these things. Better than being on your ship. How about another drink?|Thaum Rystra, to the Rebel agents that he encountered in Dalia, on a breaking storm|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
Thaum Rystra had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and thick, wavy black [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. He stood at 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height and weighed approximately 68 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="Child of Light" /> Rystra was intelligent<ref name="Light and Dark" /> and adept at lying, and when he traveled to Dalicron-4 he was willing to play the part of a friendly traveler so as to maintain his cover. When not in the company of his master Valik Kodank, he carried himself in a cheery manner, his eyes sparking with life and sporting a contagious,<ref name="Child of Light" /> crooked smile,<ref name="Light and Dark" /> akin to that of a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]].<ref name="Soulsaber" />

As a child, Rystra had a close relationship with his parents, particularly his mother. Though he developed a loyalty to the Empire and an eagerness to bring justice to the Empire's enemies, he was horrified when the Empire had him murder his parents and he consequently turned his back on his Imperial masters. He came to see the Empire's New Order as evil and vowed to fight back against it, joining the Rebel Alliance as a means of repentance for his crime. His actions left him feeling uncomfortable when in the presence of a fellow Force user so he disliked working alongside a Force-sensitive Twi'lek during his early service to the Alliance. He requested a post as a Rebel scout as he felt that he needed some time alone and when his transfer request was approved, he was excited at the prospect of a role where he could provide valuable intelligence to Alliance without facing a constant reminder of his past sins.<ref name="Child of Light" />

When Rystra was first lured to the Temple of Pain by Valik Kodank, he was impressed by how dark and cool the stronghold felt due to the dark side power radiating from the structure and he was overcame by a hunger for the Force like he had never experienced before.<ref name="Child of Light" /> He became devoted to Kodank and was convinced that only she could bring stable government to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />

Rystra felt disappointed by the failure of Tol Skaros to capture Caeleb on Dalicron-4, though owing to his caution and patience he chose to allow the Rebel agents that had killed Skaros to leave the planet unhindered and to capture Caeleb at a later date. He was pragmatic and when confronted by the Rebels at the Cavern of Light though he threatened to kill Caeleb if the group tried to prevent him from taking the Soulsaber he did not plan to make good on his threat, reasoning that the boy's death would not gain him anything yet would make the Rebels more unrelenting in their pursuit of the darksider. Though he also did not seek to kill the Rebel agents, he was willing to do so if faced with no other option.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

During the three years following his recovery of the Soulsaber, Rystra visibly aged, gaining a tired look to his eyes, a graying of his hair and hard lines on his face. He fell increasingly under Kodank's control and lost control of many of his faculties and when the Rebel agents traveled to the Temple of Pain to confirm him, he sought to destroy them at all costs. Rystra had little regard for the New Republic, considering it to be too similar to its predecessor, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], which had allowed the Empire to come to power.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|So, you are the ones that have pursued Thaum across the reaches of space. There is much power in your group. Yes, much power. Join Thaum Rystra and ally yourselves with me! The galaxy will fall to our might. I shall rule with you as my chiefs.|Valik Kodank, to the New Republic agents that Rystra lured to the Temple of Pain|<ref name="Light and Dark" />}}
Rystra was proficient in the use of the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|grip and move objects]], to [[Force stealth|travel stealthily]], to affect the minds of others,<ref name="Child of Light" /> to [[Force speed/Legends|move with speed]],<ref name="Soulsaber" /> to [[Force healing/Legends|heal himself]] and to sense the world around him. He was also adept in wielding the Force powers [[battlemind]], [[Enhance Attribute|Enhance Ability]] and [[Force empathy/Legends|empathy]].<ref name="Child of Light" />

Rystra was familiar with the fighting techniques used by the Jedi,<ref name="Child of Light" /> in combat he was capable of using his Force prowess to levitate himself or others and to push over his opponents.<ref name="Soulsaber" /> Following his training from Kodank during the years following his theft of the Soulsaber, Rystra mastered the dark side powers of [[hatred]] and [[Force Enrage|rage]]. He also became skilled in Sith sorcery and could physically alter other sentient beings, making them stronger, more robust and more relentless in combat, though frequently as the cost of his subjects' sanity.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

In addition to [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]], Rystra was [[Language/Legends|fluent]] in the language [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]].<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Me. Me. Do I look like a spice smuggler?!|Thaum Rystra, to the Rebel agents that he encountered on Dalicron-4|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
Rystra wielded an [[Amethyst/Legends|amethyst]]-colored lightsaber and a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 blaster pistol]], and he was also equipped a set of macrobiniculars, a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]<ref name="Child of Light" /> and some thermal [[Detonator/Legends|detonators]].<ref name="Soulsaber" /> He also carried a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith masking amulet]] that concealed his Force presence from other Force users. As his means of transportation, Rystra operated an MRX-BR Pacifier, a fast and well-armed model of scouting vessel that possessed powerful [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] capabilities.<ref name="Child of Light" />

Though Rystra possessed the [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes of a Jedi]] and a [[Clothing/Legends|cloak]], he wore them infrequently so as to blend in with the galactic population. On his assignment to Dalicron-4, the Dark Jedi donned a dark green [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]], a brown [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] hide [[Clothing/Legends|vest]] and matching black nerf hide [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="Child of Light" /> During his confrontation with the New Republic agents at the Temple of Pain he wore dark-colored robes.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thaum Rystra featured as one of the primary antagonists of the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]], a trilogy of [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventures written by [[Lee Pickler]] and set within ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' continuity that were published by [[RPGA]]. Rystra first appeared in ''[[Child of Light]]'', the opening instalment of the trilogy, released in [[2000]].<ref name="Child of Light" /> He featured again in the second adventure of the saga, [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']], published in [[2001]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and the closing chapter of the trilogy, [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']], released in [[2002]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />

An inconsistency exists between ''Light and Dark'' and an outline of the ''Child of Light'' saga set out in ''Child of Light'' regarding Rystra's actions during his confrontation with the New Republic agents at the Temple of Pain.<ref name="Child of Light" /><ref name="Light and Dark" /> ''Child of Light'' states that in the final adventure of the saga Rystra attempts to resurrect Kodank by wielding the Soulsaber to convert Caeleb's [[Force energy]] into dark side energy to return her to life.<ref name="Child of Light" /> In ''Light and Dark'' however, Caeleb does not appear and Rystra does not attempt to use the Soulsaber to resurrect Kodank, who instead tries to regain physical form by possessing Sha'lia.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> This article depicts Rystra's actions during the battle in accordance with the potrayal of those events set out in ''Light and Dark''.

===Possible roleplaying outcomes===
{{Quote|We need your help. Can we come aboard?|Thaum Rystra, to the ''Child of Light'' player characters, seeking their support in the search for Zanner if the players chose to wait out the storm on Dalicron-4 in their starship|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
In the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]], the players roleplay as the Rebel agents that Rystra encounters on Dalicron-4<ref name="Child of Light" /> and subsequently at the Cavern of Light<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and the Temple of Pain,<ref name="Light and Dark" /> and Rystra's actions can be influenced by the decisions of the players.<ref name="Child of Light" />

In ''Child of Light'', the players can choose to wait out the storm that erupts on Dalicon-4 either in Daz's Tavern or in the players' starship. If the players choose to linger at Daz's tavern, when the child Zanner is reported missing Rystra approaches the Rebels in the inn to enlist them in the search for the missing boy. If the players wait in their starship, Rystra and Corvin approach the ship in the pouring rain and Rystra taps on the vessel with a hydrospanner to attract the group's attention, then requests to be invited aboard and asks for their assistance in the search for Zanner. He also proffers guidance on flying the starship in the stormy conditions. When the Rebels subsequently locate Zanner and find the child to be injured, either Rystra or Corvin insist that the group take the boy to the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Aloor]] for treatment if the idea to do so does not occur to the players. Caeleb's sister [[Jhara]] is seriously injured by Tol Skaros when the Whiphid attempts to abduct the boy and if the players mention her condition to Rystra upon their return to Dalia with Caeleb, Rystra offers to assist her.<ref name="Child of Light" />

During ''Soulsaber'', if the player characters arrive at the Cavern of Light as Caeleb is retrieving the Soulsaber for Rystra, the Dark Jedi urges the child to speed up. If the Rebels try to convince Caeleb not to hand over the Soulsaber to Rystra, the darksider is angered and warns the player characters not to get involved. Rystra does not initiate combat with the Rebels but retaliates if attacked. When Rystra then moves to flee with the dark side relic various options are possible for how he can secure his escape. Rystra can alternately levitate Caeleb above a chasm and threaten to throw him over unless the Rebels allow the Dark Jedi to leave; mind trick the player characters with the Force into assisting him or loosing recognition of him; use the Force to knock the Rebels over; or use the Force to fly himself to safety.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

In ''Light and Dark'' Rystra dispatches four pirate starfighters to harry the player characters on their approach to the Temple of Pain and if following combat any of the pirates attempt to flee, Rystra remotely detonates their starships. When Kodank casts an illusory version of Rystra to converse with the New Republic agents inside the temple, if the player characters attempt to fight him the phantom Rystra swings its lightsaber to deflect their attack and then disappears. Rystra and Kodank's battle with the player characters at the end of ''Light and Dark'' can also conclude in various ways; it is possible for Rystra to be defeated and killed and Kodank vanquished, or conversely for Rystra and his master to be victorious and for Kodank to successfully possess Sha'lia. If Kodank's spirit is destroyed, Rystra is stricken by grief and madly attacks the player characters.<ref name="Light and Dark" />
